items.title: Bley Carla — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I think it was Oscar Goodstein and, Mom... it starts with an M, Maury? No... Maury... another gangster. But I don’t know what his name was.

ctx.x: So I had to turn in all my tips and make up, so I had to get tips it was really weird. And that club that was, I forget who owned it, but I think it was Oscar Goodstein and, Mom... it starts with an M, Maury? No... Maury... another gangster. But I don’t know what his name was.
So with you and Paul, the relationship was kindled there of course, with… in New York for how long before moving back to L.A.? And what?
